p_intro: IntuSketch helps you create AI portraits from how you see yourself, optional face-trait inputs, optional friend feedback, and a photo you may choose to share. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and the choices available to you.
p_p_children: IntuSketch is not intended for children under 13. If you believe a child has shared personal data with us, please contact us and we will take appropriate steps.
p_p_retention: We retain information only for as long as needed to operate the app, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce our agreements, and protect the service. You may request account deletion in the app where available, or by contacting support.
s_intro: For account, billing, privacy, or technical questions, email intusketch@gmail.com. Please include your device model, iOS version, and a brief description of the issue.
s_meta_desc: Help with accounts, billing, privacy, and portrait generation.
s_priv_p: Request account deletion in the app where that option is available, or email us. Privacy-related enquiries can go to the same address.
t_p_medical: IntuSketch is a creative self-reflection and portrait product. It is not medical, psychological, diagnostic, biometric, therapeutic, or professional advice. AI-generated outputs may be incomplete, inaccurate, or subjective and are not factual statements about you.
s_friend_p: Share links only with people you trust. If a link was shared by mistake, email us with details and we will assist where we can.
p_p_photo: Providing a photo is optional. Do not upload images of other people unless you are entitled to do so. Share friend-feedback links only with people you genuinely trust.
